enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, fan running on low for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Bends knees. Breathes steadily. Turns to right side. Straightens legs. Pulls blanket down slightly. Turns onto back. Places arms at sides. Remains still. Turns to left again. Reaches for blanket. Pulls it over shoulders. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Walks to sink. Turns on tap. Washes hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water in the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread and milk. Closes refrigerator. Fills kettle with water. Presses button to boil. Takes bread slice. Places in toaster. Presses lever. Toaster pops. Takes toast. Spreads butter. Pours hot water into mug. Adds milk. Sits at table. Eats toast. Drinks. Stands up. Clears dishes. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for work and packing bag, laptop and notes for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out trousers. Lays clothes on bed. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Buttons shirt. Puts on trousers. Zips trousers. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Ties shoelaces. Walks to desk. Picks up laptop. Places laptop in bag. Picks up notes. Places notes in bag. Picks up charger. Places charger in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out.

Walks to bus stop. Boards bus. Pays fare. Sits down. Rides bus. Pulls cord. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks to office building. Opens door. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Exits elevator. Walks to office door. Opens door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and meeting partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Picks up phone. Calls partner organization. Talks on phone. Hangs up. Opens program files. Reviews program plans. Makes notes. Walks to meeting room. Sits at table. Discusses with colleagues. Takes notes. Walks back to desk. Types document.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to lunch place. Enters restaurant. Orders food. Pays. Waits. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Finishes. Clears table. Stands up. Walks out. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work at the office: planning upcoming community events, updating schedules and preparing program materials
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens event planning document. Types details. Checks calendar. Updates schedule. Makes phone calls. Sends emails. Prints materials. Collates papers. Staples documents. Places in folder. Walks to printer. Picks up prints. Returns to desk. Organizes folder. Reviews materials. Saves files. Closes computer. Stands up. Stretches.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Watches stops. Pulls cord. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks to home. Opens door. Enters home. Closes door. Takes off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner using the induction cooker and microwave, keeping high-power appliance use short during the peak tariff window
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Closes refrigerator. Takes out cutting board. Cuts vegetables. Takes out pot. Places pot on induction cooker. Turns on induction cooker. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Opens microwave. Places bowl inside. Closes microwave. Presses buttons to start. Microwave beeps. Opens microwave. Takes out bowl. Turns off induction cooker. Places food on plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats food. Chews. Swallows. Drinks water. Continues eating. Finishes meal. Stands up. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Places plate in sink. Picks up cloth. Wets cloth. Wipes counter. Rinses cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting quietly and reading, avoiding heavy appliance use during the peak price period
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up book. Sits on bed. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes book. Places book on bedside table. Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Rests. Turns to side. Pulls blanket. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the couch and reviewing the next day's community program notes on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens notes app. Scrolls through notes. Reads notes. Makes edits. Types on phone. Saves notes. Places phone on armrest. Reaches for remote. Turns on TV. Watches TV. Picks up phone again. Checks messages. Replies to message. Puts phone down. Watches TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower now that the peak tariff period has ended
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Waits. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Lathers body. Rinses body. Picks up shampoo. Applies to hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around hair. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Drying hair, skincare routine and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Removes towel from hair. Picks up hair dryer. Plugs in. Turns on. Dries hair. Turns off. Unplugs. Places hair dryer down. Picks up face wash. Applies to face. Rinses face. Picks up towel. Pat dries face. Picks up moisturizer. Applies to face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the dishwasher and running it off-peak, tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens dishwasher. Picks up plates from sink. Places in dishwasher. Picks up glasses. Places in dishwasher. Picks up cutlery. Places in basket. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Presses start button. Wipes counters. Picks up crumbs. Throws in bin. Sweeps floor. Puts broom away. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, setting an alarm and reading briefly
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up phone. Opens alarm app. Sets alarm for 6:30. Puts phone on bedside table. Picks up book. Sits on bed. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Reads another page. Closes book. Places book on bedside table. Turns off desk lamp. Lies down. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Remains asleep. Turns onto back. Places arms at sides. Bends knees. Straightens legs. Turns to left. Pulls blanket up. Turns to right. Remains still. Breathes deeply.
